sequences.name: Monster
sequences.description: Beyonders of this Sequence often fall into a kind of trance, sometimes whispering things others cannot understand, making others consider them some kind of real Monster.
abilities: Perception: Super high spiritual Perception; often hear sounds others couldn't hear and see things others couldn't see, occasionally seeing the future with acute intuition for danger.

sequences.name: Robot
abilities: Physical Enhancement: All aspects of physical abilities significantly improved.
Mental Enhancement: Powerful calculation skills and precise control; proficiency in Divination and Anti-Divination.
Perception: Stronger Perceptive ability to detect danger and ominous auras.

sequences.name: Lucky One
abilities: Passive Luck: Often encounter Lucky events; Luck fluctuates and is unpredictable.

sequences.name: Calamity Priest
abilities: High Spirituality: Spirituality surpasses that of other Pathways.
Calamity Attraction: Passively suffer Calamities but can see them in advance; can actively attract Calamities to affect enemies.
Psyche Storm: Can directly affect opponent's Spirit Body, causing dizziness and lostness.

sequences.name: Winner
abilities: Foresight: Very keen sense of Foresight; experts in Divination and Anti-Divination.
Curse of Misfortune: Can Curse enemies with limited Misfortune.
Passive Luck: Can begin to control their own Luck and accumulate Luck.
Psyche Storm: Can create pure Psyche Storm that sweeps Spirit Bodies with drowsiness and Calamity.

sequences.name: Misfortune Mage
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Body transformed into Mercury Body with passive Anti-Divination and Anti-Prophecy.
Misfortune Field: All beings within range are Cursed with Bad Luck.
Group Blessing: Can give Luck to creatures within 50-meter radius by consuming Luck reserves.
Blessing: Can Bless a chosen target with Luck using own or pulled future Luck.
Absolute Perception: Absolute Perception over changes in Fate and existence of Beacons.
Curse of Misfortune: Can Curse target with life-threatening Bad Luck.
Psyche Storm: Qualitative change; causes confusion and madness in addition to dizziness.
Mythical Creature Form: Incomplete Mythical Creature Form.

sequences.name: Chaoswalker
abilities: Fate Keeper: Can discern Disordered elements of Fate and evade or Seal them.
Spiritual Baptism: Makes target's spirit clean, stable, and no longer Disordered.
Disorder: Partial authority over Disorder; can make Predestined Fate Disordered.
Mythical Creature Form: Can respond to prayers.

sequences.name: Soothsayer
abilities: High Spirituality: Can utilize Spirit World to influence Dreams and Mirrors.
Fate: Partial control over Fate authority; encompasses Good Luck, Bad Luck, and Foresight.
Prophecy: Can Prophesy how different results will occur; spoken Prophecies have high probability of becoming reality.
Revelation of Fate: Can gaze upon the long River of Fate to receive Revelations.
Words of Fortune & Misfortune: Can bring Good or Bad Luck upon living beings within 30 kilometer radius.
Mythical Creature Form: Complete Snake of Mercury.
Body of Mercury: Body has passive ability to not be hit and not be influenced within ten seconds.

sequences.name: Snake of Mercury (Giant Serpent, Snake of Fate, Tail-Devouring Serpent of Fate)
abilities: Cycle: Partial authority over Cycle and Save/Select authorities.
Cycle of Fate: Can make people fall into a strange state where Time is fixed within a certain range, circulating repeatedly.
Reboot (Reboot of Fate/Reboot of all things): Can Reboot the state or events within a certain area.
Words of Fortune & Misfortune: Enhanced ability to grant Luck and Misfortune.
Mythical Creature Form: Full Snake of Mercury; giant scaleless snake with dense patterns and symbols.

sequences.name: Wheel of Fortune
sequences.description: To an extent, 'They' are equivalent to the embodiment of Fate, capable of roaming freely in the River of Fate.
abilities: Fate: Core authority derived from Fate symbolism; embodiment of both Good Luck and Bad Luck.
Foresight: Partial authority of Foresight; can grasp the River of Fate to obtain visions of the future.
Good Luck: Authority of Good Luck subordinate to Fate authority.
Probability: Core authority; can manipulate the Probability of events and behaviors.
Cycle: Derived from Return symbolism; includes Reincarnation domain shared with the Mother.
Disorder: Authority manifesting the Disorder symbolism; essence of Fate is Disorder.
Light Cone World: Divine Kingdom; completely Probabilistic realm.
